title: Automation event WiFi SSID contains space
body:
I am currently using AndroidAPS 3.1.0.2

I have an automation that triggers a temp basel based on time and wifi ssid.  This automation works, however the SSID location I key off has recently renamed and has a space in it.  I believe having a space in the WiFi SSID causes the automation to not trigger.

comments.body:
delimiter is set to ';'
it should work
added to tests and it's working even with space https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/06ece9747cf5ad2b836ca41eb1c9e79fca22737c
Thanks, I will look back at my end.  Sorry for wasting your time.

@M1Sports20 did you find a solution? I'm also trying to build an automation and my SSID contains spaces, it does not seem to 'detect' the condition. When i turn Wifi on and Off, the trigger works. but it seems that it's not evaluating current visible SSID's, so its more of a trigger than a condition

The space was not my problem.  I had another condition preventing the automation.
